fields.help: Defines the product’s display order for clients. By default, products are sorted alphabetically, but a higher priority (0–1000) moves the product higher in the list. The default priority is 0.

intro: Stripe (via Zooza) will collect money on your behalf. Payouts are made twice a month or monthly, depending on the volume of transactions. There is no setup required. A standard transaction fee of 3.5% is deducted from every transaction. Please note, this payment method does not support refunds.

cards.title: Gift Card › Choose the type of product item

fields.label: Add product item type
options: Video — Any video from the document's library. The video will be available after the order has been completed
Document — Any document from the document's library
Prepaid Credit — When used, the credit will be recorded as a payment for programme. The booking's debt will remain the same. This is recommended for entry passes or prepaid credit.
Entry pass — Instead of prepaid amount, your clients will be able to purchase a certain number of entries to your sessions
Discount — Credit will be recorded as a discount when applied to a booking. The booking's debt will be reduced by the credit amount.
Service — Any service provided outside the application. Useful for camps when additional services such as insurance, parking, extras, etc. are needed.
